'''Manning''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Marblewood security force|security force]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]]. In collaboration with his companion [[Tawb]], he protected the [[Black Sun sector chief|sector chief]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], [[Avrak Villachor]], as a his personal security guard.<ref name="Scoundrels" />
